title: Suggestion: Shabbath Mode.
symptom: The user requests a 'Shabbath Mode' feature that would automate certain functions during Shabbat, such as turning on the screen at intervals, setting brightness to lowest, enabling airplane mode while keeping necessary connections, and silencing alerts. The thread later clarifies that the user also wants an option for a 0.1 mg/dl threshold for rising/falling alarms, but that is a separate issue.
evidence_quote: I am asking to add a 0.1 mg/dl option. Same for the falling threshold.
